title: Our Impact
content:
Our Impacts

We are 501(C) registered NGO in the US and Liberia

We have created safe spaces for learning, mentorship, and personal growth where women and youth can build leadership abilities, develop new talents, and strengthen their voices. Many participants in our programs have gone on to start small businesses, return to education, take on leadership roles, and become advocates for change in their communities.

Our outreach efforts have increased awareness on important social issues such as gender equality, education, health, youth participation, and community responsibility. By engaging families, local leaders, and stakeholders, we have helped strengthen community support systems and encourage collective action.

More about the Foundation

We believe that women empowerment is the most.

Donate to Support

Deserving People

At B4P CODEFOUND, our impact is measured by the lives we touch, the opportunities we create, and the positive change we inspire within communities. Through our programs and initiatives, we have empowered women and young people with knowledge, confidence, and practical skills that help them become more independent and active contributors to society.

Through partnerships and collaboration, B4P CODEFOUND continues to extend its reach and deliver meaningful support to underserved communities. Every training session, mentorship opportunity, awareness campaign, and community project contributes to building stronger women, inspired youth, and more resilient communities.

The true impact of B4P CODEFOUND is seen in transformed lives, renewed hope, and communities that are better prepared for a brighter future.
